parole.testo: Borrowed from Greek or Byzantine Greek καλόγερος (kalógeros), possibly partly though a Slavic intermediary; compare Serbo-Croatian kaluđer, Bulgarian калугер (kaluger). Cf. also Aromanian cãlugãr.

parole.significato: dish (flat round object), especially one used in church services to collect money
parole.testo: Borrowed from Greek δίσκος (dískos), partly through a Slavic intermediate.
